name: The Desert Refuses Its King
description:
A caravan reports a crown moving beneath the sand. Rowan asks that this one never reach a throne.

Use the Desert Eye to seek Cataclysm's Cursed Pyramid and prepare for the Ancient Remnant encounter. Defeat the named boss once; tracked earlier kills may count.

Legacy commendation: a victory or advancement earned on another story path can satisfy this record. This does not create a separate instance of the encounter.
